name: QueryEdgeDriverVersion

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 30. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。最大取值30，最小取值1，默认取值是10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Minimum value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。最小取值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The driver ID. In the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), go to the **Driver Management** page and hover over the target driver name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html operation to obtain the driver ID
parameters.help_zh:
驱动ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**驱动管理**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html接口获取
parameters.name: driver_id

parameters.help_en: The driver version number. If you set this parameter, only the driver version information that matches this version number is returned
parameters.help_zh: 驱动版本号。设置该参数表示仅查询该版本号匹配的驱动版本信息
parameters.name: driver_version

parameters.help_en:
The driver version status.

- 0: queries unpublished driver versions.
- 1: queries published driver versions
parameters.help_zh:
驱动版本状态。

- 0：表示查询未发布的驱动版本。
- 1：表示查询已发布的驱动版本
parameters.name: version_state
